def find_first_duplicate(nums)
  x = -1
  for i in nums
    if nums.count(i) > 1
      if x == -1
        x = i
      end
    end
  end
  return x

end

  end

def sum_even_and_even_index(arr, n)

    end
    i += 2
  end
  return sum

end

  imbalance = 0

def swap_count(s)
  count_left = 0
  count_right = 0
  swap = 0
  imbalance = 0

  chars = s.chars
  for i in 0..chars.length
    if chars[i] == '['
      count_left += 1
      if imbalance > 0
        swap += imbalance
        imbalance -= 1
      end
    else if chars[i] == ']'
      count_right += 1
      imbalance = (count_right - count_left)
      end
    end
  end

  return swap

end

end

      end
      j += 1

def extract_date(url)
  r = url.match(/(\d{4})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{2})/)
  return [[r[1], r[2], r[3]]]

end

def sum_even(l, r)
  sum = 0
  for i in (l..r)
    if i % 2 == 0
      sum += i
    end
  end
  return sum

end
